_comment: Which measured seed backs each modality's UN cards, and the generator's
own version. The regulation editions are NOT repeated here: each seed
records the edition it was read from, and the manifest reports that
value, so the two can never disagree. Bringing a new edition in means
re-running the extraction workflow that produces the seed (see
docs/dg-coverage.md), after which this generator picks it up unchanged.
A modality without a seed is listed with the reason; its cards fail
